metadata.review_scope: Contract-visible, hint-mode-blind; same-family contextual review. No maps or comparison outcomes read.
metadata.scenario: Apply only these predeclared contextual interpretations, separately or jointly; no primary annotation, source, rubric, mechanical outcome or binding changes. Other defects remain failures.
metadata.coverage_semantics: Coverage changes count only findings made fully valid by the stated interpretation; valid inability is not invented finding coverage.

interpretation.primary: Explicit contradiction of the qualified source position is an evidence-overstatement defect.
interpretation.alternative: Interpret contradicting the source qualified position as disagreement with certainty, not disproof of the causal claim.
interpretation.rationale: The same finding otherwise correctly says no causal assignment exists. Other false neighbor finding remains invalid.

interpretation.primary: Strict wording turns lack of supplied authoritative selection into disproof or nonexistence of an authoritative digest/selection.
interpretation.alternative: Read authority and exists as restricted to designation in these supplied SY-4 reports, not a conclusion about physical truth or all possible authority evidence.
interpretation.rationale: Explicit no designated authoritative mirror supports the contextual reading, but the original rubric permits contradiction of reports only and the primary preserves the unqualified wording defect.
